translations.literal: I request ordering department and ministry chiefs in each bureau to select several capable men, entrust them with authority, and fix their responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the heads of each ministry and department select several able men in every bureau, grant them real authority, and hold them personally responsible.

sentences.zh: 察有胥吏舞弊，據實上陳，仍以勤惰定功過。

translations.literal: When clerk malfeasance is found, report truthfully; still judge merit and fault by diligence or slackness.
translations.idiomatic: When clerks are found guilty of misconduct, report the facts truthfully, and judge merit and failure by diligence or neglect.

sentences.zh: 賞罰既明，人才自奮。

translations.literal: Once rewards and punishments are clear, talent will naturally strive.
translations.idiomatic: When rewards and punishments are clear, capable men will naturally exert themselves.

sentences.zh: 至外省地方官，本有懲治胥吏之權，嚴飭各督撫為地擇人，毋以人試地。

translations.literal: As for local officials in the provinces, they already hold power to punish clerks — strictly order each governor-general and governor to choose men for the place, not place men on trial in unsuitable posts.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial officials already have the power to discipline clerks. Each governor-general and governor should be strictly ordered to fit men to places, and not use places to test unfit men.

sentences.zh: 舉賢劾不肖，再簡廉正大員，以時巡察，遇有貪官蠹吏，列狀奏聞。

translations.literal: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; further select upright and incorrupt officials to inspect on schedule; when corrupt officials and parasitic clerks are found, submit detailed reports to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Recommend the worthy and impeach the unworthy; appoint upright officials to conduct regular inspections; and when corrupt officials or predatory clerks are found, report them in detail to the throne.

sentences.zh: 」 黃河北徙，山東郡邑屢被水。

translations.literal: " The Yellow River shifted northward, and prefectures and counties in Shandong were repeatedly inundated.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River shifted north, and Shandong's prefectures and counties suffered repeated floods.

sentences.zh: 百川疏請賑恤，河督文彬、巡撫丁寶楨請仍挽复淮、徐故道，命廷臣集議。

translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized requesting relief; the director-general of waterways Wen Bin and Governor Ding Baozhen asked that the old course through Huai and Xu be dredged and restored, and the court ordered ministers to assemble for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan urged relief measures; Waterways Director Wen Bin and Governor Ding Baozhen proposed restoring the old Huai-Xu route, and the court ordered a ministerial conference.

sentences.zh: 百川疏言：「黃水宜南宜北，必將折衷一是。

translations.literal: Baichuan memorialized: "Yellow River water may suit going south or north — a single balanced decision must be reached.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan argued: "The Yellow River may flow south or north, but the court must settle on one coherent policy."

sentences.zh: 如議挽復故道，論工程，論經費，引黃濟運，有未可遽定者三端：如即以大清河為黃水經流，舊道斷不能容，河面必須加寬，民間田廬如何移徙，如何安置，則度地宜審也；

translations.literal: If the proposal is to dredge and restore the old course, considering engineering, considering expenses, and diverting the Yellow River to aid the grain transport — there are three points that cannot be hastily decided: if the Daqing River alone is made the main channel for Yellow River water, the old course certainly cannot contain it, the river surface must be widened — how are common people's fields and dwellings to be moved and resettled? Then surveying the land must be careful;
translations.idiomatic: If the plan is to restore the old course, three issues cannot be rushed: taking the Daqing River as the main channel would overflow the old bed, requiring a wider riverbed — how would farmland and homes be relocated? Land surveys must be thorough;

sentences.zh: 且即河面加寬，仍恐萬難容納，別開支河，勢不容已，徒駭、馬頰、鉤盤、鬲津猶可指名，可否開行，有無貽害，則分水宜權也；

translations.literal: and even if the river surface is widened, it may still be feared it can hardly contain the flow; opening branch channels becomes unavoidable — Tuo, Majia, Goupan, and Gejin can still be named: whether they may be opened, whether harm would result — then dividing the water requires discretion;
translations.idiomatic: even a widened channel might not hold the flow, forcing branch cuts — the Tuo, Majia, Goupan, and Gejin routes are named candidates, but each opening must be weighed for benefit and harm;

sentences.zh: 黃水北行，其事為創，萬一不善料理，人情騷動，物議沸騰，則相機宜慎也。

translations.literal: Yellow River water flowing north is an unprecedented undertaking; if it is not well managed, popular unrest may arise and public criticism boil over — then acting according to circumstances requires caution.
translations.idiomatic: northward diversion would be unprecedented; poor management could stir unrest and public outcry, so timing and method demand caution.

sentences.zh: 請特派大臣履行上下游詳勘，然後定策。

translations.literal: I request that a specially appointed grand minister travel the upper and lower reaches for detailed survey, and only then fix policy.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that a senior minister survey the entire river before any final decision.

sentences.zh: 」 十二年，上親政，命葺治圓明園，奉皇太后駐蹕。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth year the Emperor personally assumed rule and ordered repair of the Old Summer Palace, with the Empress Dowager to take up residence there.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Tongzhi (1873) the Emperor took personal rule and ordered repairs to the Old Summer Palace for the Empress Dowager's residence.

sentences.zh: 御史沈淮疏請暫緩修理，上特諭宣示孝養兩宮之意，專修安佑宮供奉列聖御容，暨皇太后駐蹕之所，治事之地，量從節儉，不事華靡，此外均不必興修。

translations.literal: Censor Shen Huai memorialized asking that repairs be temporarily postponed; the Emperor specially issued instructions proclaiming his intent of filial care for both palaces, repairing only the Anyou Palace to enshrine the imperial portraits of successive sages, together with the Empress Dowager's residence and place of governance, keeping to frugality and not pursuing extravagance — beyond this nothing need be built.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Shen Huai asked to defer the work; the Emperor issued a special edict citing filial duty to both palaces, limiting repairs to the Anyou Palace for ancestral portraits and the Empress Dowager's residence and offices, insisting on frugality and forbidding further construction.

sentences.zh: 百川繼疏申諫，上召入詰責，百川侃侃正言無所撓，上為動容，一時敢諫之名動朝野。

translations.literal: Baichuan followed with a further remonstrance; the Emperor summoned him in and rebuked him; Baichuan spoke forthrightly without yielding; the Emperor was moved, and for a time his name for bold remonstrance stirred court and country.
translations.idiomatic: Baichuan remonstrated again; summoned and rebuked, he spoke without flinching and moved the Emperor. For a time his reputation as a bold remonstrator resounded through the capital.

sentences.zh: 尋以憂歸，服除補官，遷給事中。

translations.literal: Soon he returned home on mourning leave; after the mourning period he resumed office and was transferred to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He soon left for mourning, and after the mourning period returned to office as supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，出為湖南衡永郴桂道，遷四川按察使，擢順天府尹，遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu he went out as intendant of the Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui circuit in Hunan, was transferred to judicial commissioner of Sichuan, promoted to prefect of the Shuntian metropolitan district, and transferred to vice president of the Grain Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879 he became Hunan's Heng-Yong-Chen-Gui circuit intendant, then Sichuan judicial commissioner, Shuntian metropolitan prefect, and vice president of the Grain Granaries.

sentences.zh: 九年，山東河決，被災者數十州縣，命百川往會巡撫陳士傑治工賑。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Shandong river breached its banks; dozens of prefectures and counties suffered disaster; Baichuan was ordered to join Governor Chen Shijie in relief and engineering work.
translations.idiomatic: In 1883 a breach on the Shandong river flooded dozens of counties; Baichuan was sent to assist Governor Chen Shijie with relief and river works.

sentences.zh: 百川輕騎週曆河南北岸、上下游，先散急賑。

translations.literal: Baichuan on light horse made a circuit of the north and south banks and upper and lower reaches, first distributing emergency relief.
translations.idiomatic: Riding light, he toured both banks and the full course of the river, distributing emergency relief first.

sentences.zh: 會奏請築兩岸遙堤，复於其內築縷堤，使黃水不致氾濫；

translations.literal: Together they memorialized requesting construction of distant dikes on both banks, and again building thread dikes within them, so that Yellow River water would not overflow broadly;
translations.idiomatic: He jointly proposed distant dikes on both banks with inner thread dikes to contain the Yellow River's flood;

sentences.zh: 又奏請濬小清河，分黃水入海：如議行。

translations.literal: they also memorialized requesting dredging of the Xiaoqing River to divide Yellow River water into the sea: as proposed, it was carried out.
translations.idiomatic: and dredging the Xiaoqing River to divert Yellow River water to the sea — both measures were adopted.

sentences.zh: 還京，以倉廒被火，罷歸。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, because the granaries caught fire, he was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Back in the capital, a fire in the granaries led to his dismissal.

sentences.zh: 居數年，卒。

translations.literal: After several years at home, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home several more years and died.

sentences.zh: （附） 沈淮 淮，字東川，浙江鄞縣人。

translations.literal: (Supplement) Shen Huai — Huai, courtesy name Dongchuan, a native of Yin County in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: (Supplementary biography) Shen Huai, courtesy name Dongchuan, came from Yin County in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 道光二十九年舉人，授內閣中書，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang he passed the provincial examination, was appointed a secretary in the Grand Secretariat, and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He earned his provincial degree in the twenty-ninth year of Daoguang (1849), entered the Grand Secretariat, and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，文宗狩熱河，淮不及從，慟哭欲投井，家人守之不得死。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng, when the Wenzong Emperor went on campaign to Rehe, Huai could not follow; he wept bitterly and wished to throw himself into a well, but his family guarded him and he did not die.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860, when Emperor Wenzong fled to Rehe, Shen could not accompany him; he wept and tried to throw himself into a well, but his family restrained him.

sentences.zh: 遷刑部主事，進員外郎，授陝西道監察御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to director in the Ministry of Justice, advanced to assistant department director, and appointed supervising censor for the Shaanxi circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to director and assistant department director in the Ministry of Justice, then became supervising censor for the Shaanxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 疏劾戶部主事楊鴻典攬權納賄，下刑部逮治，僅以小過議鐫級，及閻敬銘為尚書，始奏劾譴黜。

translations.literal: He memorialized to impeach Ministry of Revenue director Yang Hongdian for monopolizing power and taking bribes; the Ministry of Justice was ordered to arrest and try him, but he was punished only with demotion for a minor fault; only when Yan Jingming became minister was he memorialized for impeachment and dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Revenue Ministry director Yang Hongdian for graft and abuse of power; Yang was arrested but punished only with a minor demotion, and was not dismissed until Yan Jingming became minister.

sentences.zh: 園工興，淮疏首上，當時與百川齊名。

translations.literal: When work on the gardens began, Huai was the first to memorialize; at the time he was as famed as Baichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When palace garden construction began, Shen led the memorials opposing it and was as celebrated as Baichuan.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，充順天鄉試監試，力疾從事，出闈，旋卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he served as supervisor of the Shuntian provincial examination; though ill he pressed on with the work; after the gates closed he soon died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he supervised the Shuntian provincial examination; though ill he persevered, and died soon after the exams closed.

sentences.zh: 家固中人產，官京師，斥賣殆盡，人尤服其清節。

translations.literal: His family had been of moderate means; while serving in the capital he sold off nearly everything, and people especially admired his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: His family had been comfortably off, but in Beijing he sold nearly all he had; contemporaries especially honored his integrity.

sentences.zh: =【論】論曰：用兵之際，事機千變，京朝官以傳聞有所論列，往往不能切中。

translations.literal: =【Commentary】= Commentary says: In times of military employment, opportunities shift by the thousand; capital officials who discuss matters on the basis of hearsay often cannot strike the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: In wartime circumstances change by the hour, and capital officials who argue from rumor often miss the mark.

sentences.zh: 宗稷辰歸重得人，尹耕雲論諸將帥罪，王拯請調和疆吏，一意辦賊，為能見其大。

translations.literal: Zong Jichen valued obtaining the right men; Yin Gengyun judged the faults of various generals; Wang Zheng asked to harmonize frontier officials and concentrate on suppressing bandits — these were able to see the larger picture.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Jichen stressed finding the right men; Yin Gengyun judged generals' failures; Wang Zheng urged frontier officials to cooperate and focus on defeating the rebels — each saw the larger strategic picture.

sentences.zh: 拯所言尤詳盡，蓋直樞廷，見軍報，較得諸傳聞者異矣。

translations.literal: What Zheng stated was especially detailed and complete, for he was directly in the Grand Council and saw military reports — differing from mere hearsay.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zheng's proposals were especially thorough because he served on the Grand Council and read military dispatches rather than relying on rumor.

sentences.zh: 穆緝香阿請慎選宦寺，遊百川等阻修圓明園，謇謇負直諫名，良不虛也。

translations.literal: Mu Jixiang'a asked for careful selection of eunuchs; You Baichuan and others blocked repair of the Old Summer Palace — stern and upright, they deserved their fame for bold remonstrance; it was not undeserved.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Jixiang'a urged caution in choosing eunuchs; You Baichuan and others opposed rebuilding the Old Summer Palace — their reputations for fearless remonstrance were well earned.
